label_rationale: started is set before the keeper hook, so register() reverts inside the window
mechanism: vesting schedule: the committed total is frozen when the keeper starts vesting
arm_reason: a state-changing callback with a user/frozen target; the general assume-guarantee arm applies

closure.justification: functions whose read/write effects intersect the proof footprint ['committed', 'started', 'totalAllocated']

composition.rule: admissible callbacks preserve I_exp; the post-phase restores I_stable, which implies phi

mcvp_rounds.ag_spec_rendered:
Assume-Guarantee specification for VestingStart_PH03a
  target property phi : !started || committed == totalAllocated
  exposure site       : start.onStart  (external interface call)
  ghost state         : (none)

  [A_cb]  ASSUMPTION
          During start's exposed phase, re-entrant control is confined to the
          callback closure ['register', 'start']; every such callback is admitted by the
          protocol, with bounded depth-one nesting.
          discharged by: conservative-closure soundness gate (static, not the LLM)

  [G_pre] GUARANTEE
          {!started || committed == totalAllocated} pre-phase {started && committed == totalAllocated}
          discharged by: OBL_pre

  [G_exp] GUARANTEE
          forall f in A_cb. {I_exp} f {I_exp}   (I_exp = started && committed == totalAllocated)
          discharged by: ['OBL_cb_register', 'OBL_cb_start']

  [G_post] GUARANTEE
          {I_exp} post-phase {!started || committed == totalAllocated /\ true}
          discharged by: OBL_post

  COMPOSITION THEOREM (instance):
    A_cb => (G_pre /\ G_exp /\ G_post) => !started || committed == totalAllocated
      where callbacks are confined to admissible_callbacks=['register', 'start'], depth-one

obligations.purpose: callback register preserves I_exp (depth-one) or is excluded by its guard during exposure
obligations.excluded: guard unsatisfiable during exposure (callback excluded from the admissible set)

obligations.purpose: callback start preserves I_exp (depth-one) or is excluded by its guard during exposure
obligations.excluded: guard unsatisfiable during exposure (callback excluded from the admissible set)
